scope.work: Read frozen source, final build configuration/DTB, and root-generated runtime evidence. No new workload or board probe performed by this reviewer.

conclusion: HS400 at actual 200 MHz is an established bus mode in the retained runtime evidence; 400 MB/s is its raw interface ceiling, not guaranteed media/system throughput.

The 8 MiB direct-read sample reached 83.92 MiB/s; two ad hoc 512 MiB repeated-file samples reached 45.01 and 48.95 MiB/s. A later frozen-probe 512 MiB sample reached 74.90 MiB/s with 2.45 worker CPU seconds. Do not publish any of these as a fixed sustained rate or attribute the difference to prefault or CPU class without controlled segment evidence.

The named t736-mmc-dma kworker accumulated 6.17 CPU seconds during the 10.459-second ad hoc window and 2.45 CPU seconds around the later 6.836-second frozen-probe transfer. This supports substantial variable worker CPU cost, but current records do not divide it among copy, MMIO, descriptor work, reset polling or other work.

Frozen source/DT/config imply a Normal Non-Cacheable coherent bounce mapping. Each ordinary read copies its full payload from that mapping to SG pages. This is the leading measurable CPU-cost candidate, not a measured allocation of all 6.17 seconds to memcpy.
Preserve v24; the next candidate should add aggregate segment observations only. Do not optimize poll/reset/request size/cache attributes before this decomposition.

raw_bus_ceiling.formula: 200000000 cycles/s * 2 DDR edges * 8 data bits / 8 bits/byte
raw_bus_ceiling.exclusions: Command/response/stop/busy and CRC/protocol overhead, media/controller limitations, and all host-side software/copy/scheduling overhead.

long_direct_read_with_diskstats.diskstats_limit: Read milliseconds accumulate request residence including block-layer queueing; 11.76 ms/request is not controller service time. The ~8.47 residence/wall ratio is consistent with multiple outstanding block requests while the host serializes requests, not 8 concurrent hardware DMAs. Whole-system CPU cannot by itself attribute cost to a thread.
long_direct_read_with_diskstats.background_io: Diskstats also record two writes/32 sectors and two flushes; the requested benchmark itself was read-only.

long_direct_read_with_worker_counters.interpretation: 82.98 MiB per worker CPU second is an end-to-end payload/worker-CPU ratio, not measured memcpy bandwidth. Endpoint CPU 5 to 4 proves neither CPU residency nor a LITTLE-core cause. No per-request segment timing or simultaneous workload attribution is retained in this log.
long_direct_read_with_worker_counters.disk_request_count: This second log has no diskstats. Its 64 KiB per-request arithmetic would be an equivalence based on the host limit, not independently counted 8192 requests.

integrity_probe.measurement_limit: Verified reads include poisoning, preadv, bytes copy, compare and two SHA256 updates. Writes include expected-buffer copy, pwritev and fsync. These phase rates are not directly comparable to no-hash direct reads or guaranteed media-only rates; cache/card conditions and short duration remain limits.

measurements.sample_scope: Ordinary-file O_DIRECT bypasses the page cache; it does not bypass card-internal caches. Repeating the same 8 MiB 64 times is not a unique 512 MiB streaming-media test. Samples are not controlled repeat statistics. The later frozen probe is the comparison protocol for a future diagnostic candidate; do not fold its different prefault/window handling into an unexplained improvement claim.

frozen_probe_baseline.protocol: Existing regular file, O_RDONLY|O_DIRECT|O_NOFOLLOW, first 8 MiB repeated 64 times, 1 MiB userspace reads; destination buffer prefaulted outside measured transfer. No integrity/hash work in the measured loop.
frozen_probe_baseline.boundary_review: Static read-only review PASS: fixed bounds, regular-file/size checks, short-read failure, final fd/path identity, PID start-time guard, correct /proc/stat field indexes. No new implementation-mirroring tests.
frozen_probe_baseline.comparison_limit: Prefault differs from the earlier ad hoc protocol, but causal improvement from prefault is not established. Endpoint CPU 5 to 7 does not establish residency or a CPU-class speedup. Collect future candidate comparisons with this exact frozen script.
frozen_probe_baseline.counter_window_limit: Process/transfer, whole-system and worker snapshots have adjacent but different endpoints, including /proc collection overhead. Their CPU deltas need not sum exactly. storage_writes=false describes no write syscall by this probe, not absence of background filesystem writes.

request_structure.copy: One full payload CPU copy per data request: SG to bounce for writes, bounce to SG for reads. Tuning-only poison is not executed on normal I/O.
request_structure.queue: alloc_ordered_workqueue with WQ_MEM_RECLAIM creates an ordered unbound worker path. One work_struct and one coherent payload buffer serialize host requests; no CQE or double-buffer pipeline.
request_structure.user_chunk_limit: A 1 MiB read syscall is still at least 16 host data requests; increasing the userspace chunk does not create a 1 MiB controller transaction.
request_structure.optional_commands: SBC runs only when mrq->sbc exists. Do not assume CMD23 for every request. Auto-stop completion depends on data->stop.

reset_and_polling.completion: Worker reads RINT and IDST; descriptor OWN scan occurs only after required completion events. IDIE enables event latching; controller global interrupt remains disabled.
reset_and_polling.hrtimer: CONFIG_HIGH_RES_TIMERS=y; usleep_range uses schedule_hrtimeout_range and an hrtimer sleeper. CONFIG_HZ=250 does not impose an unavoidable 4 ms sleep on this path. Actual scheduled run time may exceed the requested sleep upper bound.
reset_and_polling.preemption: CONFIG_PREEMPT_NONE=y; no timing guarantee from the requested usleep upper bound.
reset_and_polling.fences: Both stop/reset fences and quarantine-after-timeout protect DMA reuse. Their measured cost is unknown; do not remove them based on assumed six sleeps.
reset_and_polling.timeout: Normal command timeout uses jiffies for a 2-second error deadline, not the normal completion polling granularity.

bounce_mapping_source_chain.classification: Expected Normal Non-Cacheable CPU mapping, established from frozen source + final DTB/config; runtime PTE not dumped.
steps: Final DTB 07824de9... was decompiled on the build host; no dma-coherent/dma-noncoherent/iommus/iommu-map properties exist.

CONFIG_ARCH_HAS_SYNC_DMA_FOR_CPU/DEVICE are enabled; CONFIG_ARCH_DMA_DEFAULT_COHERENT is absent in generated autoconf.h. kernel/dma/mapping.c initializes dma_default_coherent to false. No ARM64/OF assignment overriding it was found.
of_dma_is_coherent traverses DMA parents and returns the false default; of_dma_configure_id passes that to arch_setup_dma_ops.
For a noncoherent device, CONFIG_DMA_DIRECT_REMAP=y selects the dma_direct_alloc remap path. dma_pgprot returns pgprot_dmacoherent.
ARM64 pgprot_dmacoherent uses MT_NORMAL_NC. This is Normal Non-Cacheable memory, not Device-nGnRE/nGnRnE MMIO.
sg_copy_from_buffer -> sg_copy_buffer (SG_MITER_LOCAL) -> memcpy(miter.addr, bounce + offset, len) for each SG mapping.
cost_not_measured: NC source-load throughput and individual memcpy duration
Time sleeping versus runnable but unscheduled in completion polling
Per-CPU residency of the worker during the measurement
bounce_mapping_source_chain.no_shortcut: Do not add a fake dma-coherent DT property or cacheable alias to speed this up. DMA coherence and buffer ownership need a separate correctness design.

next_minimal_candidate.name: v25 aggregate diagnostic only; v24 remains frozen
next_minimal_candidate.single_changed_variable: Observability only; add bounded aggregate timing/counters gated by an explicit default-off boot option. No timing, reset, DMA, request-limit, affinity, rail or PLL behavior change.
segments: request enqueue to worker start (dispatch wait)
worker start to mmc_request_done entry (host service wall)
pre-transfer t736_dma_stop separately from remaining dma_start
descriptor/setup and write-copy separately if attributing dma_start cost
command submission through polling completion (hardware plus sleep/scheduling wall, not hardware-only time)
counts: read/write requests and bytes, segregating normal I/O from tuning
poll-loop iterations/sleep attempts without per-poll timestamps or printk
CPU index sampled at selected segment endpoints, explicitly not a residency histogram
error counts and max/total wall time per segment
next_minimal_candidate.measurement_surface: Read-only debugfs aggregate snapshots before and after one existing approved read-only workload; subtract totals. Avoid per-I/O logs, payload retention, counter-reset requirements, or a broad benchmark expansion.
next_minimal_candidate.attribution_limits: ktime wall segments can include interrupts/scheduling; task worker CPU endpoints independently bound CPU use. Do not label a command wait interval pure device time. CONFIG_SCHEDSTATS/FTRACE/KPROBES/PERF_EVENTS are disabled in v24.
next_minimal_candidate.why_not_poll_change_first: Reducing 50-100 us waits increases wakeups and may add CPU cost while missing a dominant NC-copy cost. Current worker CPU evidence argues for decomposition first.
next_minimal_candidate.why_not_request_limit_change_first: Larger requests need larger bounce/descriptor capacity, bounds review and ownership snapshot changes: current snapshot stores only 64 OWN bits. This is not a one-constant behavioral experiment.
next_minimal_candidate.state: Proposed diagnostic, not implemented or tested by this reviewer.
